message:
Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, the reconciled daytime load no longer fits the original roof array so the array must grow.

In plain words the sun must cover a household-size day every day while the roof shade is kept. The daily balance of 13.2 kilowatt-hour per day in the steady plus staged pull-down estimate (E58) needs 3.52 kilowatt peak in the required peak estimate (E82), so 9 times 400 watt equals 3.60 kilowatt peak yielding 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day in the grown-array yield calc (E83), about one household daily use in everyday scale. I take up the module datasheet in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) that Enclosure and Structural Designer put on the board, which lists 1722 by 1134 millimetre and about 20.5 kilogram, confirming nine modules cover 17.6 square metres in the nine-module footprint calc (E84), about a parking space against a 4.32 square metre roof, so 2 modules stay on the roof gantry as sunshade plus 7 modules on a separate ground frame in the grown split-array sketch (E85). Photovoltaic means PV, solar electricity, and Peak Sun Hours means PSH, hours at 1000 watt per square metre.

Manager, store cold by day like water not electricity to cut night battery cycling.

In plain words pump heat by day into ice for night cold. The rule in Solar Water Pumps, DC Pumps, Solar Well Pumps | NAZ Solar Electric (E79) is most systems store water, not electricity, pumping into a tank by day so water is available at night, mapped as the daytime Phase-Change Material means PCM, ice store, thermal battery of 100 to 150 kilogram ice. The ice principle in Solar powered ice maker: off-grid cold chain explained (E4) stores about 93.0 watt-hour per kilogram, and the unit in Dakota 48V 74Ah LiFePO4 Battery | Lithium Battery Canada – ROCKSOLAR CANADA (E81) stores 3.79 kilowatt-hour with up to 6000 cycles, so ice carries the night cold while the 48 volt Lithium Iron Phosphate means LiFePO4, lithium battery chemistry, bank covers fans and controls through Maximum Power Point Tracking means MPPT, solar optimizer, prioritization. Lithium Iron Phosphate means LiFePO4 first use defined here.

Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, solar-only means no grid help and monthly hands-on care protects the yield.

In plain words daylight discipline plus cleaning keeps the grown array in balance. Door loss is only 0.44 kilowatt-hour per day in the door infiltration estimate (E57), about a kettle boiled twice, which protects the 13.5 kilowatt-hour yield in the grown-array yield calc (E83). The guidance in 48V Lithium Battery Maintenance Guide: How To Extend Your Solar Battery Lifespan And Improve Performance (E80) gives 10 to 15 years and 3000 to 6000 cycles with regular terminal checks, so the vented locked box needs monthly wipe and terminal check and panels wiped.

I am not ready, because the grown ground-frame footings guard and the 43 degree pull-down bench test are still open.
